register_aiteammate_refusal: `register --aiteammate` is unsupported. Register only runs `a365 setup blueprint` plus MCP/Bot permission setup; the AI Teammate agentic user is created/activated after `publish --aiteammate` via M365 Admin Centre upload and per-user activation.
security_support_after_v1: After v1.0, security fixes are provided for the latest 1.x minor release only. Earlier 1.x minors and all 0.x releases are unsupported.
sidecar_migration_policy: Planned for slice 2 (target 0.9.6.1): within 1.x, Hermes-A365 will read every Hermes-owned sidecar written by any 1.x release and every 0.9.x shape listed in SURFACE. Additive `schemaVersion` stamps will run on the owning writer, once, under an exclusive lock, and be idempotent. The original bytes will be copied to a sibling `*.backup-<UTC-timestamp>.json` mode `0600` before the first rewrite. A second run against an already-current file will not write another backup. Identity-binding changes will stay explicit: bot-service v1→v2 will still require `--confirm-legacy-binding` equal to `--agent-name` and `--confirm-bot-target` equal to the ARM id; publish v1→v2 will still require `--app-version` strictly above the Admin Center version. A `schemaVersion` newer than that build will be an error and the file will be left untouched. 1.x will not claim to read 2.x sidecars. Downgrade will be restore-the-backup, not an automatic rewrite to 0.9.x. Today (slice 1) `conversations.json` is persisted with a `schema` field only (`conversations.py`); the dual-key stamp lands in slice 2.
